thread:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — we're pushing a breaking change to partner webhook signatures (v1 -> v2 HMAC SHA256 with url+body). Need partner coordination window and SDK updates.
Samir Patel: timeline? can we make backward-compatible for 2 weeks?
Maria Chen: target rollout: 2024-07-15 canary, 2024-07-29 full. We'll support dual verification for 30 days.
Jenna Liu: docs/SDKs — I'll add verification helpers to node/python/ruby. ETA: 1 week for PRs.
Omar Reyes: ops question — will this affect marketplace integrations that proxy webhooks? we need a header example and fallback mode.
Maria Chen: good q. We'll keep old header X-RI-Signature for v1, new is X-RI-Signature-V2. Security suggests HMAC(secret, url + body + timestamp).
security-bot: Suggested signature format:
```
X-RI-Signature-V2: t=1690000000,v1=...,v2=abc123signature
```
Include timestamp and versioned sigs.
Samir Patel: Partner-success — pls notify top 10 partners tomorrow and schedule 1:1s for any questions.
partner-success: on it. I'll include upgrade checklist, sample code, and deprecation TTL. Ask which partners need extended window.
Jenna Liu: SDKs will accept both headers by default during dual-mode. We'll add an opt-in strict mode behind env var.
Omar Reyes: logging — add a metric for signature-mismatch_count and a trace id in early failures.
Maria Chen: +1. Also plan for rollback: if mismatch spikes >0.5% in canary, pause rollout.
security-bot: Don't forget to rotate webhook secret rotation doc.
partner-success: Draft email done, sending to the partner list at 10am. cc product and security.
Maria Chen: thanks. I'll open the coordination checklist and link PRs in this thread. :thumbsup:
